name: JL_BR_AR_RET_INTERFACE_ALL
description: This interface table is used for importing bank returns.

columns.name: FILE_CONTROL
columns.description: Bank control file name received from the bank.

columns.name: ENTRY_SEQUENTIAL_NUMBER
columns.description: Register sequence number on electronic file received from the bank.

columns.name: REGISTER_TYPE
columns.description: Identifier for header, detail and trailer records in electronic file received from the bank.

columns.name: TRADE_NOTE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount due remaining on collection document received from the bank.

columns.name: FILE_GENERATION_NUMBER
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: COMPANY_CODE
columns.description: Company code provided by the bank at the time of contract for services associated with the remittance and return of a collection document.

columns.name: COMPANY_NAME
columns.description: Company name of the first party associated with the company code provided by the bank.

columns.name: GENERATION_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the interface records were generated.

columns.name: REMITTANCE_CODE
columns.description: Bank remittance code in electronic file from the original line sent by the company.

columns.name: BANK_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique numeric identifier for a bank.

columns.name: BANK_OCCURRENCE_CODE
columns.description: Occurrence code returned by the bank related to a bank occurrence.

columns.name: OCCURRENCE_DATE
columns.description: Correction date for a bank occurrence received from the bank.

columns.name: INSCRIPTION_NUMBER
columns.description: Company registration number in electronic file received from the bank.

columns.name: COMPANY_USE
columns.description: Collection document unique identifier for matching purposes.

columns.name: OUR_NUMBER
columns.description: Collection document identifier generated by the bank or the company responsible for the collection document printing.

columns.name: PORTFOLIO_CODE
columns.description: Portfolio code in electronic file received from the bank.

columns.name: YOUR_NUMBER
columns.description: Collection document number related to the document given by the company.

columns.name: DUE_DATE
columns.description: Due date for a collection document received from the bank.

columns.name: COLLECTOR_BANK_NUMBER
columns.description: Numeric identifier for collecting bank.

columns.name: COLLECTOR_BRANCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Numeric identifier for collecting bank branch.

columns.name: TRADE_NOTE_TYPE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: BANK_CHARGE_AMOUNT
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: ABATEMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Abatement amount for a bank collection document received from the bank.

columns.name: DISCOUNT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Discount amount for a bank collection document received from the bank.

columns.name: CREDIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Credit amount for a collection document received from the bank.

columns.name: INTEREST_AMOUNT_RECEIVED
columns.description: Paid interest amount for a collection document received from the bank.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_NAME
columns.description: Customer name on a collection document received from the bank.

columns.name: RETURN_INFO
columns.description: Return information comment on a bank occurrence on a collection document received from the bank.

columns.name: BANK_USE
columns.description: Operation identifier by bank on electronic file received from the bank.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PIX_QR_CODE_EMV
columns.description: QR Code in smart payment format returned by the bank that's associated with a collection document.

columns.name: PIX_QR_CODE_URL
columns.description: QR Code URL returned by the bank that's associated with a collection document.
